name: Obex Packaging
old_description: Obex specializes in Gravure Printing; a high quality process utilized for long print runs.
about:
Obex Packaging, Inc. operates from Reno, Nevada, where it has served the printing and film industry for more than 20 years. The company is a family-owned business that emphasizes strong communication and customized products and shipments to address each client’s needs.

The company specializes in rotogravure printing for custom packaging, offering custom-built solutions to exact specifications. It also provides a stock packaging line in various sizes and materials, along with labels featuring anti-tamper features. Additional capabilities include die-cut pouches, inside-print security features, and hand holes for easier handling. Obex reports serving more than 250 brands, from startups to global industry leaders.

Obex works with a broad range of clients, including startups and established global companies across various sectors. The company’s packaging and label solutions are used by brands seeking custom branding, stock packaging, or anti-tamper labeling.

The company emphasizes building strong client relationships through communication and customization, aiming to exceed expectations by tailoring products and shipments to each client’s needs.
